title: The nonlocal attraction-repulsion transport equation with power kernels
summary: We study a nonlocal continuity equation on $\mathbb{R}^d$ in which a probability density is driven by the competition between attraction toward a prescribed background measure $ω$ and self-repulsion among particles, governed respectively by the power-law kernels $ψ_a(x) = |x|^{1+a}$ and $ψ_r(x) = |x|^{1+r}$ with exponents $a, r \in [0,1)$. We establish global Lagrangian well-posedness via a squared-radius regularization, obtaining {finite-time $L^\infty$ and moment bounds}, $W^{n,\infty}$ regularity, and uniqueness in the Lagrangian class.
